hypotheses.title: Batch 76: Tri-Candidate Gold Consultant Elevation (Targeting Fitness >= 1.50+)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly targets elevating Batch 75 winning candidates into the Gold Consultant Approved Tier (Fitness >= 1.50): (1) Candidate 1: Adapts the 8-PASS Analyst Consensus Yield engine into TOP1000 with Subindustry Neutralization and Decay 6 to compress large-cap turnover and lift Fitness above 1.50. (2) Candidate 2: Enhances the proven TOP2000 Candidate da600b5e (Sharpe 1.51, Sub-universe 1.53, Self-corr 0.5616) with 90-day revision lookback and Decay 7 to reduce turnover from 14.2% to ~10%. (3) Candidate 3: Elevates Candidate 4bcbb0f8 (Sub-universe Sharpe 1.69 SPECTACULAR, Sharpe 1.31) with 80/10/10 weighting and Decay 6 in TOPSP500 to compress turnover from 23% to ~13% and easily clear the 1.00/1.50 Fitness thresholds.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if higher decay horizons degrade sub-universe Sharpe below 1.20.
